title: Lighthouse Stripes
brief: Weave a bold striped cloth in lighthouse colours: cherry red, sea-foam white and a band of deep night blue, bright enough to spot from any boat.
notes: Red and white, like a lighthouse
Bold stripes: seen from the sea!

nova: The lantern looked so cosy last night. Now I want stripes to match!
A thin blue stripe is like the sky just after sunset. Perfect.
Maybe Pip finally gets an outfit from this one…
pip: Stripes are all about counting. I like counting.
If the stripes drift, everyone will see it. They won't drift.
gull: Red and white yarn! Very nautical. The seagulls approve.
A good southerly breeze today. Perfect for cargo.
Must keep the white yarn out of the spray.
